method: Seven barycentric samples per actual transformed triangle. Core containment uses all outward convex-core face halfspaces with 1e-7m strict-inside threshold. Visibility casts from 0.2m outside cone toward each sample along 80 Fibonacci sphere directions and checks first-hit owner and sample proximity <=2e-6m. Positive samples establish exposed surface; zero samples do not mathematically prove total burial. No model/export edits.
